prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset: one complete, exceptionally detailed transparent RGBA adventure-boardgame map illustration of TESORO, a unique raised pirate town. EDIT IMAGE 1's rough composition sketch into the finished painting.
Input roles: IMAGE 1 is the edit target and spatial composition/envelope guide. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the approved sculptural colorful watercolor storybook painting style. IMAGE 3 is ONLY the sea palette of the eventual map, not a background to copy.
Keep the town-to-mountain sequence and asymmetrical diagonal spread of image1, but replace every flat schematic stroke with beautiful hand-painted intricate 3D-readable illustration. The pale footprint and dark blue guide background must become genuine TRANSPARENCY, no hexagons or guide shapes visible. Keep every painted detail, mast, lighthouse, cliff, foam, and shadow comfortably inside the pale allowed silhouette. Complete uncut scene with transparent margins. Elevated oblique map view from the sea/south, approximately 60 degrees downward, warm light from upper left.
FOREGROUND: an almost impenetrable contiguous carpet of dozens of tightly interlocked varied wooden sailing ship HULLS, decks, planks, masts, rigging and iron chains, jumbled organically rather than neat identical boats. Furled sails so roofs and platforms remain visible. Narrow dark water slivers only between hulls, no large navigable blue inlet, no open lagoon. Ship mass fills BOTH lower lobes of guide and stretches under the front of town. Short localized turquoise foam at exterior edge blending to transparency, no painted ocean rectangle.
ACCESS AT FAR LEFT END: at the outer west end of this town, rough steep stone stairs climb from ship level to a small rocky lower landing. ONE narrow hanging rope ladder then climbs to the front entrance of a conspicuous TWO-STOREY wooden TAVERN on high stilts, weathered red roof, balconies and warm windows. This tavern is the entrance gate: the ONLY route from this landing to the raised town passes THROUGH the tavern, emerging from its REAR door to the first suspension bridge. No side bypass from the landing to another platform. The access is NOT in the middle of town. Clear small steps and ladder, not a broad stone road.
TOWN: a lively irregular cluster of timber buildings with differently colored roofs on several DISTINCT raised wooden platforms. Substantial long exposed timber piles, deep shadow underneath, sagging ROPE SUSPENSION BRIDGES with plank decks and rope railings connect the platforms. Some rooms hang BELOW platform level among the piles. Buildings vary in size; exact count free. Tiny barrels, laundry, rope coils, balcony railings, chimneys, lamps and spars are implied pirate-town details, lovingly legible on zoom. Show separated platforms, not an ordinary continuous waterfront street or flat solid pier.
OPPOSITE END / BACK RIGHT: the far end of the raised settlement directly meets a single imposing steep rocky cliff rising to a sharp SNOW-CAPPED MOUNTAIN behind town, filling upper-right lobe. Craggy sculptural warm grey/ochre rock, small snow ledges and a difficult narrow snowy footpath winding from the far city platform around the side of the peak. The trail turns out of sight behind the summit. A SMALL lighthouse is on the FAR SIDE of the mountain: only its upper tower and lantern peek around and above the right shoulder of the peak. Its base is occluded by rock, NOT placed prominently in front of mountain, NOT a giant second tower. Leave the snow and lighthouse fully inside the guide envelope.
Style: match image2's colorful dimensional richly detailed watercolor adventure book art, crisp painterly edges and tactile rock/wood, vibrant warm timber and red/ochre/teal roofs against cool snow. Strong distinctive silhouette readable at tiny map size and intricate coherent details at larger size. Avoid dark night rendering; use shaded understructures with luminous daylight on roofs and snow.
Constraints: a single coherent scene; no text whatsoever, no place names, no lettering on buildings, no banner, no watermark, no people portraits, no decorative detached icons, no visible grid, no pasted hex tiles, no round island surrounded by broad open sea. Not a generic harbor. Preserve all details in frame, actual transparent background.
